findings.evidence: Vertices.lean:39 `(h : IsTriangulable.{v} X)` returns `ι : Type v`; the diffeotopy and embedding steps place no universe constraint on ι.
findings.fix: Take `htri : IsTriangulable.{v} M` and return `∃ (ι : Type v) ...`.
findings.issue: `exists_triangulation_vertex_image` requires `htri : IsTriangulable.{u} M` with `ι : Type u`, so it only applies when the triangulation lives in the same universe as `M`. The proof itself never needs this: `exists_finite_triangulation_card_ge` is universe-polymorphic.

findings.evidence: Topology/Triangulable/FiniteCWType.lean:41-49: `(h : IsTriangulable.{v} X) : FiniteCWType X` with the comment `-- Relabel the finite vertex set into the universe of the space.`
findings.fix: Take `IsTriangulable.{v} M`. Before applying `instFiniteCWTypeComplVertexImage`, relabel the finite vertex type to `ULift.{u} (Fin n)`, as FiniteCWType.lean:48–49 does.
findings.issue: `finiteCWType_compl_of_isTriangulable` takes `IsTriangulable.{u} M`, which is stronger than the sibling convention: `IsTriangulable.finiteCWType` accepts `.{v}` and handles the universe mismatch by relabelling the finite vertex type.

findings.evidence: `IsTriangulable.finiteCWType {X : Type u} ... (h : IsTriangulable.{v} X)`; `hX` appears only in `haveI := hX.finiteCWType`.
findings.fix: Use `hX : IsTriangulable.{v} X` now, and `hY : IsTriangulable.{w} Y` once the Puncture lemmas are generalized.
findings.issue: `hX : IsTriangulable.{u} X` and `hY : IsTriangulable.{u} Y` pin the triangulation universe. `hX` is only passed to `hX.finiteCWType`, which accepts any universe, so its restriction is unused. `hY`'s restriction comes only from the Puncture lemma.

summary: The new puncture and Euler-formula theorems fix the triangulation universe to the space's universe (`IsTriangulable.{u}`). The existing `IsTriangulable.finiteCWType` accepts `IsTriangulable.{v}` for any `v` by relabelling the finite vertex type, and `exists_finite_triangulation_card_ge` in this PR is also `.{v}`.
